Background and Education

Ishan Bhatnagar was born in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and later grew up in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. He comes from an academically inclined family background which influenced his interest in governance and public administration.
He completed his schooling from Delhi Public School, Bhopal and later pursued B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) from National Law University (NLU), Delhi, one of India’s leading law institutions.
During his law studies, he developed a strong interest in subjects related to constitutional law, administrative law, governance, and social structures, which later complemented his UPSC preparation.
